nodes.description: Oasis market interface instance stored in contract storage.
Public address of the Oasis market contract.
Public constant address of the DAI token used as buy gem.
Public constant address of the WETH token used as sell gem.
Mapping address => uint256 tracking ETH collateral locked by depositors.
Mapping address => uint256 tracking minted token balances.
Constructor: sets marketAddress and instantiates the Oasis market.
Payable deposit that credits msg.sender locked balance with msg.value.
Mints tokens against the current Oasis-derived price.
Burns caller tokens, reducing tokenBalance.
View returning the token value of a user at the current price.
Withdraws locked ETH after zeroing the locked balance.
View that queries the Oasis market best offer and derives a price rate.
SafeMath.mul with overflow assertion.
SafeMath.div integer division.
SafeMath.sub with underflow assertion.
SafeMath.add with overflow assertion.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller address.
msg.sender.transfer(payout): external ETH call executed inside withdraw before function return.
amount*1e18 unchecked multiplication performed before SafeMath.div in mint.
buyAmt*1e18 unchecked multiplication performed before SafeMath.div in getPrice.
locked[msg.sender] += msg.value unchecked arithmetic accumulation in deposit.
Constructor parameter addr, the market contract address.
mint amount parameter controlling how many tokens are produced.
burn amount parameter controlling tokens destroyed.
tokenValue user parameter whose balance is priced.
Local offer id returned by market.getBestOffer.
Local pay amount from market.getOffer tuple.
Local buy amount from market.getOffer tuple.
Local pay gem address from market.getOffer tuple.
Local buy gem address from market.getOffer tuple.
Local current price returned by getPrice inside mint.
Local minted token quantity computed in mint.
Local payout amount copied from locked[msg.sender] in withdraw.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter addr is written into marketAddress.
Constructor assigns marketAddress.
Constructor instantiates the market state variable from marketAddress.
msg.sender indexes the locked mapping credited in deposit.
deposit writes the locked state mapping.
deposit performs the unchecked locked[msg.sender] += msg.value arithmetic.
msg.sender is used as the index in the locked balance update.
Unchecked accumulation is stored into the locked mapping.
msg.sender determines whose locked balance is checked in mint.
mint amount parameter drives the token computation.
mint reads locked[msg.sender] in its require statement.
mint calls getPrice, which depends on external oracle state.
mint amount parameter is multiplied by 1e18 unchecked.
mint executes the unchecked amount*1e18 multiplication.
Unchecked multiplication result flows into the tokens local.
currentPrice from getPrice is used to compute tokens.
mint uses SafeMath.div to convert amount into tokens.
mint uses SafeMath.add to credit tokenBalance.
mint writes the tokenBalance mapping.
burn amount parameter is validated and subtracted.
msg.sender selects the tokenBalance entry burned.
burn updates the tokenBalance mapping.
burn uses SafeMath.sub to reduce the balance.
tokenValue user parameter selects the balance to price.
tokenValue reads the tokenBalance mapping.
tokenValue calls getPrice which relies on the external market.
tokenValue uses SafeMath.mul to compute value.
msg.sender determines the payout and the locked balance reset in withdraw.
withdraw requires tokenBalance[msg.sender] to be zero.
withdraw reads and zeroes the locked mapping for msg.sender.
withdraw copies locked[msg.sender] into the payout local.
payout value flows into the external transfer call.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external ETH transfer.
withdraw executes the external transfer to the caller.
The external transfer gives msg.sender control and can re-enter withdraw before state finalization semantics are relied upon.
getPrice calls the market state variable.
getPrice passes weth to market.getBestOffer.
getPrice passes dai to market.getBestOffer.
getPrice stores market.getBestOffer result into id.
getOffer tuple assigns payAmt.
getOffer tuple assigns buyAmt.
getOffer tuple assigns payGem.
getOffer tuple assigns buyGem.
buyAmt is multiplied by 1e18 unchecked for the price rate.
getPrice executes the unchecked buyAmt*1e18 multiplication.
Unchecked multiplication result is divided to produce the returned rate.
getPrice uses SafeMath.div for the rate computation.
The unchecked amount*1e18 product is divided via SafeMath.div inside mint.
The unchecked buyAmt*1e18 product is divided via SafeMath.div inside getPrice.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument only feeds marketAddress initialization.
mint amount is a transient input consumed inside mint.
burn amount is a transient input consumed inside burn.
user parameter is only used to index tokenBalance within tokenValue.
id is a temporary holding market.getBestOffer output.
payAmt is a temporary tuple decode used for the rate computation.
buyAmt feeds the unchecked multiplication in getPrice.
payGem is an unused decoded tuple element.
buyGem is an unused decoded tuple element.
currentPrice is a transient result of getPrice consumed by mint.
tokens is the intermediate result credited to tokenBalance in mint.
payout is the value passed directly to the external transfer call.
